subject.title: ci(release): fail fast in Telegram validation

question: Should the trusted Telegram release lane intentionally fail after 60 seconds of credential contention and after one failed canary attempt?
rationale: These are deliberate release-policy tradeoffs rather than mechanical correctness defects, and repository policy reserves acceptance of the reduced transient-failure tolerance for the relevant human owners.

options.title: Accept fail-fast policy
options.body: Keep the one-minute wait and single canary attempt, then merge after current-head live proof and remaining checks pass.

options.title: Retain transient tolerance
options.body: Add a cleanup-safe canary retry or lengthen credential acquisition before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-fast policy
recommendation.body: Keep the one-minute wait and single canary attempt, then merge after current-head live proof and remaining checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The current release workflow and Telegram QA CLI contract trace to this contributor's recent merged work.
